body:
## Summary
- Harden the macOS Host hardware compatibility evidence gate with source tree, install path, pinned signing leaf, canonical designated requirement, Microphone TCC, TCC auth_reason, and TCC csreq identity-bound requirements.
- Tighten read-only macOS Host readiness preflight around accepted user-consent TCC reasons and TCP listener process identity.
- Refresh the retained blocked current-base compatibility evidence and runbooks so the added requirements stay explicit.

## Claim Boundary
- This does not close the macOS Host hardware compatibility matrix.
- This does not mark Phase 0 stable release as pass; the aggregate remains blocked.
- This only strengthens offline/read-only fail-closed validation and the retained blocked evidence shape.
- I did not start the Host GUI, trigger Screen Recording/Accessibility/Microphone/Keychain/System Settings prompts, run `swift run`, or intentionally run `make baseline-macos-host-readiness`. During the first PR creation attempt, the shell expanded backticked PR body text and accidentally invoked `make baseline-macos-host-readiness`; it exited blocked, only wrote ignored `.build/` artifacts, and left tracked files unchanged.

## Verification
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest scripts.tests.test_macos_dev_host -v` -> Ran 149 tests, OK.
- `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=tools python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_macos_hardware_compatibility tools.tests.test_phase0_stable_release -v` -> Ran 99 tests, OK.
- `make evidence-tools-test` -> Ran 1427 tests, OK.
- `make release-tools-test` -> Ran 423 tests, OK.
- `make phase0-stable-release-gate` -> `aggregate_verdict=blocked`, `can_mark_phase0_stable_release=False`.
- `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS` in the retained evidence directory -> all OK.
- `git diff --check` -> clean.
title: test(evidence): harden macos host readiness gate
